question: At what height does the Jet Streams blow in India during winter months?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 9-13 km.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The pattern of air rotation bandied over is witnessed only at the lower position of the atmosphere near the face of the earth.
 
• Spurt sluice, narrow, nippy currents or tubes of air set up at heights ranging from 7 to 8 mi (11.3 –12.9 km) above the face of the earth.
 
• spurt aqueducts get bifurcated into two branches, after striking with the Tibetan mounds.
 
• All of Western and Central Asia remains under the influence of westerly winds along the altitude of** 9- 13 km from west to cast.**
